faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our plans and billing.

items.question: Can I use doXmind for free?
items.answer: Yes! The Free plan includes all core AI features — chat, inline editing, autocomplete, knowledge base, and web search. It's perfect for personal use and exploration.

items.question: What happens when I run out of AI credits?
items.answer: AI credits reset at the beginning of each billing cycle. If you run out before then, you can upgrade to a higher plan anytime for more credits.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan anytime from your dashboard. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: We use Stripe for secure billing. Plans are billed monthly. You can manage your subscription, update payment methods, and view invoices from your dashboard.

items.question: What is the Early Bird offer?
items.answer: The first users to upgrade to Pro get a special discounted rate of $2.99/mo instead of $4.99/mo. Once the early bird spots are gone, the standard price applies.
